## How it was checked

- [ ] `corepack pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm test`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm check:graphs` (when a recipe or graph changed)
- [ ] the node pack's `pytest` (when `comfy-nodes/` changed)
- [ ] tried in the app (`corepack pnpm demo` is enough when no render is involved)

## Checklist

- [ ] No workflow files of other people, no model files, no private paths or addresses in the diff
- [ ] UI wording uses the real terms; the plain explanation goes in the `?` tooltip
- [ ] No hard-coded card or VRAM figures
